rows.note: For mental tension or strain, 壓力 is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: I’ve been under a lot of tension at work lately.
example.traditional: 最近返工搞到我好有壓力。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 faan1 gung1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 jau5 aat3 lik6

rows.note: Use 矛盾 when the tension is an actual conflict between people, sides, or opposing forces.

example.english: The two of them argue all the time, and there is a lot of tension between them.
example.traditional: 佢哋兩個成日鬧交，大家之間有好大矛盾。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 seng4 jat6 naau6 gaau1 daai6 gaa1 zi1 gaan1 jau5 hou2 daai6 maau4 teon5

rows.note: Use 緊張感 for suspenseful tension deliberately created in a film, book, or other story.

example.english: This film maintains tension from beginning to end.
example.traditional: 呢套戲由頭到尾都保持住緊張感。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 jau4 tau4 dou3 mei5 dou1 bou2 ci4 zyu6 gan2 zoeng1 gam2
